methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $13M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Sarla Aviation is a Series A-stage transportation company that has raised $13M to date. The broader transportation sector peer set includes 8 private companies (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, FleetZero among them) and no public comparables. Within this universe, however, same-stage and adjacent-stage peers meeting valuation similarity criteria are insufficient in number to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Consequently, the analysis relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $13M capital raised proxy, implying a valuation of $26M. This single method result anchors the triangulation output.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $22M (low) to $30M (high), with a median point of $26M. Key uncertainties limiting confidence include the absence of narrow-set comparable transactions in transportation at similar stages and valuations, and reliance on a single applicable methodology. Future iterations would benefit from either identification of additional same-stage transportation peers or inclusion of revenue/unit metrics to cross-check the stage-progression assumption. The current range should be treated as indicative pending additional market data.
